author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
CATL's 5C ultra-fast charging battery can fully charge in 12 minutes and maintain 80% capacity after 3,000 cycles, equivalent to 1.5 million miles of driving. This technology uses advanced coatings, electrolyte additives, and temperature-responsive separators to prevent degradation and improve safety during rapid charging.

Source Article: https://interestingengineering.com/videos/catl-unveils-1-1m-mile-ev-battery
